# Axial Skyrmions

- The reflection changes the sign of only one of the pion fields, resulting in a relative phase definition that differs by an addition of π compared to refs.[3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is obtained by changing the sign of all three pion fields.
- The definition used in this paper allows for a more natural comparison with the similar situation for monopoles.
- The profile function is zero at a radius s/2 from the centre of the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion), enabling the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion to be patched together continuously, with the fields set to the vacuum outside each of the cores (3.10).
- In addition to the initial conditions using the simple ansatz (3.7), more sophisticated initial conditions were also used based on the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge n map.
